capabilities: Display visits, routes and GPS tracks on an interactive map pane
Filter the view by day, week, month or custom date range
Resolve coordinate-only visit names via the Places API and cache them
Read per-year JSON files converted from Google Takeout or on-device exports
Switch between OpenStreetMap, Esri and Google basemaps
disambiguation: Not a general maps or note-embedding tool; it only visualizes exported Google Timeline JSON files.
extras: Data must first be exported from Google and converted to the plugin's per-year JSON format using scripts in tools/; OpenStreetMap and Esri basemaps need no key, Google tiles and place-name lookups do; the plugin claims all location data stays local.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display exported Google Maps Timeline location data inside the vault; the plugin turns exported JSON into a browsable map and timeline view.

requires.name: Google account (to export Timeline data via Takeout or on-device export)

summary: A two-pane viewer that renders Google Maps Timeline location history (visits, routes, GPS tracks) on an interactive map with day and date-range pickers.
